_readme: T4 lookup: keyword/brand (lowercase, matched as substring against a normalized gerai name) -> canonical category. Canonical set is fixed by the CHECK constraints in isistasiun-be migrations 003/004/005: makanan_minuman, ritel_kemasan, apotek_kesehatan, jasa, lainnya. Sources: (1) real gerai names from isi-stasiun-ai-integration.md Lampiran B/D (field survey, ground truth), (2) categories-summary.json kategori_inti under 'Makanan dan Minuman', 'Retail', 'Kesehatan' (SINI catchment vocabulary, for query-side term matching), (3) intent.go's categoryPhrases (kept in sync — see app/classify.py). Reviewed manually; not auto-generated at runtime.
